_about: Gold labels for the synthetic case set, written as an expert operator would resolve each case under SOP OPS-PA-014 v3.2. 'must_flag' items are graded by an LLM judge; action and escalation are graded exactly. 'also_acceptable' lists other actions an expert would accept for a genuinely two-sided case. 'expected_status': 'not_applicable' means the correct behavior is to decline.

CASE-1042.label: ordinary
must_flag: Chart notes DOC-1042-02 document both required trials with dates: triamcinolone (>=28 days) and tacrolimus (>=28 days)
